title: Deployment-stage execution
summary: Materialization reuses schema metadata and one operation-local run/stage membership and plan-selection projection. Canonical shared groups are resolved once when private copies need retirement; later operations read fresh withdrawals and attachments. Admission and source/target authority remain checked by their existing owners. Production proof resolves the member project explicitly and checks public-ref wire identity; missions record actual population and retain the relay deadline. Execution-count observations match the exact run, stage and member, excluding concurrent campaigns for unrelated subjects. Takeover changes current run ownership in existing records; snapshots, requirement IDs, execution IDs, cursor, leases, review bundles and prior observations remain intact. Successor materialization reuses inherited private/shared/run-level rows and adds genuinely new obligations. Execution-ID continuation is available while the successor is created, deploying or failed, without granting stage acceptance.
